chore(deps): bump body-parser, fast-uri, markdown-it, proxy-addr and handlebars (#1989)

Five Dependabot PRs were open for lockfile-only bumps, several with
security fixes, and each needed its own rebase and CI run.

This combines them into one lockfile update: body-parser 1.20.9,
fast-uri 3.1.9, markdown-it 14.3.3, proxy-addr 2.0.8 and handlebars
4.7.10.

Closes #1988, #1987, #1983, #1980, #1981.

- **mocha 12 (#1986) and @graphql-tools (#1979) are left out** because
both raise the Node version needed to run the tests locally.

Tested with `npm ci`, build and unit tests on Node 24. Integration tests
left to CI.
